sources.head: Imithombo
sources.waits: Imigqa eyengezwa umthombo ilinda lapha uze uyamukele.
sources.request: Funda lokhu: {what}. Kokunye nokunye iqoqo “{name}” ({place}) elingakabi nakho, engeza umugqa kulo onalokho okushoyo. Ungashintshi omunye umugqa.
sources.fileRequest: Uma leli fayela lingolu hlobo: {what}, lengezele umugqa eqoqweni “{name}” ({place}) onalokho elikushoyo. Ungashintshi omunye umugqa. Uma kungenjalo, ungenzi lutho.
